_comment: Single source of truth for the software apps shipped by this monorepo. Consumed by scripts/build_site.py (GitHub Pages landing page + deploy copy list) and scripts/publish_portfolio.py (portfolio cards + Obsidian notes). `description` is the full portfolio-card copy (HTML-ready); `desc` is the short landing-page blurb. `links` are relative to the deployed site root (https://juwpegatron.github.io/projects/<rel>). Extra fields `image_alt`, `project_id`, `label` (thumbnail aria-label) and `desc` reproduce the live markup verbatim.

apps.name: Orbis
apps.desc: Communication, identity and protection in one app
apps.description: Communication, identity, and protection in one app: a zero-dependency Python backend + SQLite + static PWA for managing replies, commitments, summaries, and personal growth tracking. Offline-first.
apps.image_alt: Abstract geometric visualization of communication and identity networks

apps.name: Peers
apps.desc: Verified reviews across 32 categories — food, travel, market, AI tools, health and more
apps.description: Offline-first single-file PWA for verified reviews across 32 category “modes” — food, travel, market, AI tools, health, finance and more. Pick a category and the feed, explore, market and writing all scope to it, with a Use it / Wait / Skip scorecard built in.
apps.image_alt: Peers app feed screen showing verified reviews

apps.name: House of Articles
apps.desc: Athlete-moment sneaker news + live market feed
apps.description: Athlete-moment sneaker news + live market feed. Static mobile and desktop prototypes driven by a versioned JSON data spine linking on-court moments to resale price moves.
apps.image_alt: House of Articles sneaker news and athlete moments feature

apps.name: Hazel
apps.desc: Desktop studio for creators — generate a video from a prompt, refine it, fan it out to every platform, and keep your storage from overfilling
apps.description: Desktop studio for creators. Generate a video from a prompt — cast the characters, choose a talking or drama scene, set the length and size — then refine it in Hazel's built-in editor and deploy to every platform at once. Also bulk-uploads photos and videos to socials, and backs up and auto-manages memories so your storage never overfills.
apps.image_alt: Hazel studio generating a video from a prompt, with character casting, scene choice, length and size controls, a storyboard and a timeline

apps.name: Sweep
apps.desc: Turn a plain-words idea into a checkable Build → Grow → Earn plan — then chat with Otto, an offline, approval-first AI operator (brand, site, posts, outreach, research, deck, insights, sheets) built to beat hosted builders on privacy and ownership
apps.description: Turn a rough app idea into a checkable Build → Grow → Earn plan — all local, offline and deterministic. A guided intake drafts your brief from plain words (no AI, no network); Sweep generates a capability matrix, a Definition of Done, a phased roadmap, Grow and Earn checklists, verification gates and a scaffold generator. Then run its built-in Operator (Otto) — a local, deterministic agent you actually chat with, organised into Overview / Create / Grow / Money / Data tabs. Otto drafts your brand kit (logo, palette, type), a one-page site, per-network posts with generated art, emails, customer outreach, a market-research brief, a pitch deck, a content calendar, a unified inbox, multi-sheet sales / stock / cost ledgers with an insights view and a plans table — all routed through an approval queue with a run log, undo, a credits meter and an autopilot toggle. Offline, encrypted at rest, fully exportable — you own everything, with no fee and no credit meter.
apps.image_alt: Sweep turning a plain-words idea into a Build, Grow and Earn plan — a guided intake, an idea brief, a generated capability matrix, a Definition of Done checklist, a scaffold file tree and a project catalog

apps.name: Virtual Bots
apps.desc: An office of AI bots you can watch and command — live activity, goals and progress across App, Web and Mobile
apps.description: An office of AI bots you can watch and command — each bot shows its role, live status and progress; a normalized activity feed streams every tool step, and you can dispatch new goals. Ships as an installable App, a desktop Web dashboard (with a 3D office) and a Mobile view; it runs as an offline simulation when no backend is attached.
apps.image_alt: Virtual Bots Office dashboard: AI bots at their desks with live status, an activity feed and a command bar

apps.name: Airiz Motor
apps.desc: Dependency-free browser console for AIRIZ motor testing — command library, serial console and macro notepad
apps.description: A dependency-free browser console that replaces the TeraTerm/CWD serial workflow for AIRIZ device motor testing — browse a categorised command library with live parameters, drive a dark serial console with scrollback and log saving, build and run test macros in a visual notepad, install it as an offline PWA, and try the whole UI in a hardware-free demo mode.
apps.image_alt: Airiz Motor Test Console dashboard: command library, serial console and macro notepad for AIRIZ device motor testing
